# UIDrop

> Free Chrome extension that extracts any website's complete design system and sends it to your AI coding assistant.

UIDrop reads live rendered CSS from every visible element on a webpage and extracts colors, fonts, spacing, border radius, shadows, gradients, and component styles into a structured design brief. One click sends the brief and a screenshot directly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor.

## Key Facts

- Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
- 100% client-side, no servers, no data collection
- Free, no accounts, no API keys
- Extracts: color palette, typography scale, spacing, shadows, gradients, component specs
- Sends to: Claude, ChatGPT (Codex), Cursor, or clipboard
- Detects light/dark mode automatically
